About

Software that has to meet the real world.

I’m a third-year B.Tech Electronics and Communication Engineering student at USICT, GGSIPU with a growing interest in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Python, VLSI, and software–hardware integration.

I’m currently strengthening my skills in Python, AI/ML, digital systems, embedded systems, and VLSI fundamentals while building projects that combine intelligent software with hardware applications.

Beyond academics, I serve as the Graphic Designer Head of the USICT Training & Placement Cell, where I’ve developed leadership, teamwork, creativity, and visual communication skills.

I’m passionate about solving real-world problems by integrating AI with embedded and hardware systems, and I’m actively seeking opportunities to learn, build impactful projects, and gain industry experience.
